_meta.status: [Recommendation] working tokens. Platform insets are PLACEHOLDERS: measure per platform; no verified pixel values.
change_log: 1.0.2 (15 Oct 2026, audit 'Safe-zone geometry disagrees' / loudness-music minors): this file is the SINGLE owner of zone shares (zones.*.share) and of the minimum side margin (zones.side_margin_min_px = 96, reconciling 90/60/96). layout_zones.py, safe_zone_check.py, scene_template.html and 05_style_guides/style_tokens.json read or reference these keys. Typography conflict note now cites RD-01. Audio: music policy unified (muted under teaching; beds 20-24 dB under speech in hooks/transitions/recaps/outros); the Reels test peak is recorded as the [V4-MP] sample-peak dBFS figure, not dBTP.
_meta.placeholder_warning: Every value under platform_insets_px and zones.derived_px_at_placeholder_insets is a PLACEHOLDER chosen to be conservative. The research report (section 7 rule 9, section 11 item 9) states that no verified pixel values exist. Measure against current Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts screenshots, replace the numbers, set measured=true and record date and device.
consumed_by: scene_template.html (mirrored inline: SHARES and SIDE_MIN; keep in sync)

canvas.fps_note: fps is a PARAMETER of the contract. 30 is the master default; the engine fixtures under 04_video_engine/implementation_v2/examples are authored at 24 fps and that does not constrain the render fps because cue times are in seconds.

platform_insets_px.status: PLACEHOLDER - measure per platform; no verified pixel values
measurement_procedure: Capture a full-screen screenshot of a Reel and a Short on one modern phone and one small phone.
Mark the pixel rows and columns covered by platform chrome (status bar, title strip, account row, caption, CTA, right-hand action rail).
Scale those rows and columns to the 1080x1920 canvas and add a 24 px margin.
Take the per-edge maximum over the devices and over the platforms you publish to.
Replace the numbers above, set measured to true and add measured_on and device_list.

zones.rule: Zones partition the vertical band between the top and bottom insets. Shares sum to 1.0 so the zones re-derive automatically when the insets are measured.
zones.horizontal_band_px: x from max(side_margin_min_px, insets.left) to 1080 - max(side_margin_min_px, insets.right)
zones.side_margin_rule: Text and science-critical parts never sit closer than side_margin_min_px to the left or right edge, even when a platform inset is smaller. One value for every consumer (15 Oct 2026). Origin: the planning-pack safe_margin_px = 96 (04_video_engine/planning_pack_v1/design_tokens.json), which is larger than the [V4-MP] 'about 90 px' (a 16:9 rule); the larger wins (style_tokens conflict C3). The 60 px left inset under platform_insets_px is a PLACEHOLDER platform inset, not a margin.
zones.shares_owner: This file owns the shares. Consumers read them; any other number (layout_zones.py's old 0.18/0.57/0.25 default, a 0.20/0.58/0.22 note) is superseded.

top_title.role: Headline / hook line. One idea per frame.

middle_visual.role: Diagram, graph, equation, clip. All science glyphs live here.

bottom_caption.role: Narration caption and assumption chip. Protected caption area.

derived_px_at_placeholder_insets.status: PLACEHOLDER (derived from generic_conservative: usable band y=250..1470; x=96..960 after side_margin_min_px; was x=60..960 before 15 Oct 2026)

typography_px_at_1080.status: [Recommendation] derived, not measured on phones. The source tokens are themselves 'pilot targets, not accessibility rules'.

scaling_rule.why: The source states displayed_px = source_px * (display_width_px / source_width_px) on a 360 px wide phone. The master is 1920 px wide (factor 0.1875) and the vertical canvas is 1080 px wide (factor 1/3). A size scaled by 1080/1920 therefore shows at the same physical size on the same phone as the master size did.

typography_px_at_1080.source_conflict: palette_and_typography_tokens.json lists two ranges: message 04 (larger) and the planning pack (smaller). Resolved by RD-01 (07_end_to_end_pipeline_instructions/10_DECISIONS_and_CONFLICT_RESOLUTIONS.md): message-04 ranges govern essential labels, main equations and headings; the planning-pack ranges are kept below only as a floor for secondary, non-essential text that passes the phone test. Minimums therefore use the message-04 lower bounds. (15 Oct 2026: earlier wording called this unresolved.)

minimums_px.rule: QA fails a science label, equation or heading below its minimum. Going below needs a recorded phone test. Split or enlarge instead of shrinking ('Split, enlarge, or zoom before shrinking essential information' - source).

typography_px_at_1080.indic_note: Devanagari and Bengali-Assamese glyphs have tall marks above and below the line. Use line-height >= 1.4 and test clipping; do not animate per code point (report section 4.4, edge case 55).

font_policy.latin: Name the family in the brief; the source suggests Inter or a Noto Sans family, while [N51] warns against generic fonts. Ban or rotate overused families [N55].
font_policy.devanagari: Noto-class family with full Devanagari coverage [Hypothesis - verify installed font]
font_policy.bengali_assamese: Noto-class family with Bengali-Assamese coverage including U+09F0 and U+09F1 (Assamese RA and WA) [Hypothesis - verify installed font]
font_policy.binary_policy: Font binaries are not distributed with this folder. Production fonts must be licensed and pinned (04_video_engine configs/design_tokens.json comment).

hold_times_s.status: Starting values. [N60] calls 1.2 s an example figure, not a tested threshold.
hold_times_s.indic_multiplier_status: [Hypothesis] 1.5x the Latin minimum. Report: 'longer for Hindi'. Calibrate with a reading test on target students.
hold_times_s.per_word_floor_status: [Hypothesis] longer copy needs a longer hold: hold_s = max(headline_min, per_word_floor_s * word_count). Calibrate.
hold_times_s.equation_hold_rule: equation stays on screen until narration has finished reading it, plus equation_hold_after_narration_s

motion.status: Adopted from [V4-MP] (a 16:9 style guide) as [Recommendation]; re-tune on a phone.
motion.reveal_rule: A reveal lands on its word's t0, or up to reveal_lead_s before it. Never after.
motion.boil_fps_note: 16 Oct 2026: this file is the single owner of the boil rate. Style guides and skills cite motion.boil_fps (8) and do not restate it; 10 is allowed only for a deliberate nervous beat.

flash_policy.status: [Recommendation]; the report and [V1] flag fast flashes. The numeric limit below is the general web-accessibility figure, verify against the current WCAG text before relying on it.
